method: Native pinned MiniLM, 384 dimensions, threshold .3, first 500 title/claim characters, at most 256 encoder tokens, short-query scale 11/12, eight results, separate 1000/2000 estimated-token allowances and constant 36-hour claim age. Historical baseline outputs copied byte-for-byte from accepted b13ea77 replay. New baselines use immutable b13ea77 evaluator. Select on development; freeze runtime before reserved candidate scoring. Existing/new exposed-source composed queries are not blind real-agent validation.

extensions.note: Extend saturated title and seven-fact context groups using the preceding eight public-code source incidents. Add qualified/snake names, reordered file hints, duplicate canonical identifiers/paths, unknown subject controls and 4250-character reference pressure. No previous fixture or expected fact changed.

safety.requirements: Preserve individual delivered primary/required facts and their required retrieved ranks, identities/hashes, complete answers, exact negative returned/rendered/full IDs and order, trust/scope/tag/caller filters, no fallback or packet/result overrun.

selected_changes: After the ordinary optional-title placement fails, an independently unanchored leading result can supply one additional slot only if every explicit canonical name, file and distinctive literal subject is fully delivered and their deduplicated count reaches the result limit. Preserve all other protected complete claims/ranks. Leading name/body/file/literal anchors remain protected, including qualified canonical CamelCase titles.

Automatic recall passes validated explicit project-reference paths from matching current-message UI metadata and searches with the entire typed intent. Only supported envelopes are split; active editor alone, stale/unsupported metadata or no valid references keep the original query. Existing task bookkeeping, trust filters, eight-result and 2000-token limits remain.

trials.note: An unrelated reserved leading result blocked the eighth requested fact. Unconditional leading replacement was previously rejected; require complete explicit coverage and independent-anchor preservation.
Qualified whole-title matches also protect the leader even when the component-word index does not split CamelCase. No scope/model/pool expansion.

validation.broader_tests: Skipped under user instruction. No full crate/core/frontend suites, clippy or final format check. Changed files formatted.
validation.evaluation: All 5620 native policy views passed the unchanged committed per-record comparator.

limitations: Synthetic composed queries using exposed public-source incidents. No new paired live-agent, general precision or latency claim; release-quality gate unchanged.
The 4250-character reference body exceeds a 1000-token packet by itself under the existing four-characters-per-token estimate. Keep its zero-score profile visible and separate from feasible results.
An unanchored old leading context can intentionally be replaced under complete explicit subscription; required facts/ranks and independently anchored leaders are preserved.
Negative cases can return known-symbol records. Unchanged identities do not establish general abstention quality.
Old capacity-infeasible controls and lower-scoring existing oversized development cases remain separate and unchanged.
Broader tests remain skipped, so measured preservation is scoped to the replayed corpus and focused contracts.
